name: The Forest's Bounty
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
narrative.objectives: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted!Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.
narrative.requestItemsText: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
